signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a single-story ranch house frontage with lawn, driveway, and street in view.

moving_indicators.evidence: Tarp-covered items and miscellaneous goods sit along the right side of the driveway, but they look more like stored or covered yard items than moving containers or boxes.

renovation_activity.evidence: Tarp-covered piles and equipment near the driveway, and a patch of bare dirt at the left edge of the lawn, could suggest project or cleanup activity, but nothing definitive such as a dumpster or crew is visible.

signals.notes: Ranch home with a green, mowed front lawn; the driveway has tarp-covered items and clutter along its right side, and a dark SUV is parked at the far right, apparently on the neighboring property's driveway.
